clue.text: Grit, that's the answer!

definitions.meaning: determination or firmness of purpose, as in a New Year's pledge kept
the solving of a problem, as when a puzzle is worked out

explanation.surface: Someone declares that sheer grit is what is needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Determination is one sense of the word, and the settling of a problem or question is the other.

clue.text: The egghead certainly looks on

parts.note: a head, egg-shaped or not, has organs of sight that look on at the world

explanation.surface: A clever intellectual watches from the sidelines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' suggests a brainy person, but here it is just a head, and what sits in a head and looks on is the pair of seeing organs.
explanation.definitionFit: Organs of sight are what anyone, egghead or not, uses to watch.

clue.text: Exercise inside alone, or in public?

indicators.note: inside tells us the exercise letters sit within the word for alone

parts.note: alone means only, as in 'only you'
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether to work out alone at home or in the open.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in public means doing it without concealment, out in the open.

clue.text: Rude in a crude way, so not presented

indicators.note: in a crude way says the preceding letters are roughly reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: Something too vulgar to broadcast was never shown.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme never broadcast or a view never voiced has not been aired or presented.

clue.text: Single — repeatedly given the bird

parts.note: single is one, the Roman numeral I
bis is Latin for twice, used in music for a repeated passage

explanation.surface: A single person keeps getting the bird, being booed again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given the bird' is British slang for being booed, but here 'the bird' is the definition: a wading bird with a curved bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-legged wading bird with a down-curved bill is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Puzzle no more!

parts.note: non is the French and Latin-derived prefix for no
plus means more, as in 'two plus'

explanation.surface: A cry that there are to be no further puzzles.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewilder someone is to leave them puzzled, unable to respond.

clue.text: A means of getting some degree of stability

definitions.text: A means of getting some degree of stability

parts.words: A means of getting some degree of stability
parts.note: read degree as a measure of heat: a device that keeps a room at a steady chosen temperature

explanation.surface: Something that helps bring about a measure of steadiness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some degree' reads as 'to some extent' but means a temperature in degrees, held steady by a heating control.
explanation.definitionFit: A heating control switches on and off to hold a room's temperature constant.

clue.text: The soup isn't on. Mere hash will have to do

indicators.note: a hash is a jumble or mess, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A diner is told the soup is off and a mere hash will have to substitute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hash' looks like a dish on the menu, but it is the signal to scramble ISN'T ON and MERE.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick Italian vegetable broth is a particular kind of soup.

clue.text: A man from the Orient making a hit

indicators.note: making suggests the letters are made into something new by rearranging them

explanation.surface: An Asian man scores a success.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Thailand, in South-East Asia, is a person from the East.

clue.text: The tale told about exemplary put-down

indicators.note: about places the word for a tale told around the example letters

parts.note: a relation is an account or narrative, a story related
EG, for example, abbreviates exempli gratia

explanation.surface: A story is recounted about a model humiliation.
explanation.definitionFit: Demotion, as in a football team dropping a division, is a downgrading or put-down.

clue.text: Enter into the part — right in

indicators.note: in shows the abbreviation for right is inserted into the word for part

parts.note: a piece is a part of something

explanation.surface: An actor is told to get right inside the role.
explanation.definitionFit: To penetrate is to enter into something, as a needle or blade does.

clue.text: Barred enclosure for the working dramatist?

definitions.meaning: a small fenced pen where an infant plays safely
jokingly, the writing implement of a playwright

explanation.surface: A caged pen is suggested as the right place for a busy playwright.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into its parts: a writer of plays works with a pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's barred pen is one sense; the other is a fanciful writer's tool used for drama.

clue.text: Outline the view taken over America

indicators.note: in a down clue, taken over places the view word above the country letters

parts.note: a prospect is a view or vista
US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: Someone sketches the scene viewed across America.
explanation.definitionFit: A brochure giving an outline of a company, school or share offer is the sense here.

clue.text: Autochthonous crew-member with an inventive mind

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a member of a ship's crew
an original is a person of inventive, unconventional thought

explanation.surface: A native sailor with a creative streak.
explanation.definitionFit: Autochthonous means native or indigenous, inhabiting a place from the earliest times.

clue.text: Set one's heart on a jug of more modern style

indicators.note: in a down clue, on puts the first piece above the second
heart picks the central letter of the word one

parts.note: a ewer is a large water jug

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a fancy jug in a modern design.
explanation.definitionFit: Something more recent in design is more up to date than what it replaces.

clue.text: Dismiss everyone in attendance

definitions.meaning: to expel or send away, as when ejecting someone
the number of people who come to an event

explanation.surface: A command to send away everyone who showed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Expelling someone is one sense; the other is the attendance figure at an event.

clue.text: Solicitors put out in back-street

indicators.note: in places the word out inside the reversed street abbreviation
back says the street abbreviation is read in the reverse direction

explanation.surface: Lawyers are thrown out into a back alley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitors' suggests British lawyers, but here it means people who solicit business, such as ticket sellers. 'back' turns ST into TS, and OUT goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: People who pester others to buy, such as ticket scalpers, solicit custom aggressively.

clue.text: The people giving Danish leader partial backing

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of Danish
backing says the word for partial is read in reverse

parts.note: some means partial, not all of it

explanation.surface: The populace give their Danish leader half-hearted support.
explanation.definitionFit: Demos is the Greek word for the common populace, the root of democracy.

clue.text: None can be held in honour, blow it!

indicators.note: held in shows the zero letter is kept inside the honour

parts.note: OBE is the Order of the British Empire, a British honour
O looks like zero, meaning none

explanation.surface: A frustrated cry that no honours can be won, so to blazes with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow it!' reads as an oath of frustration but defines a woodwind instrument, which one blows.
explanation.definitionFit: A double-reed woodwind is played by blowing into it.

clue.text: Some patriot howled down this Roman emperor

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A patriotic crowd shouted down a Roman emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'down', but 'howled down' belongs to the surface; 'down' is a link word, and the definition is 'this Roman emperor'.
explanation.definitionFit: Otho reigned briefly in AD 69, the Year of the Four Emperors.

clue.text: Arrears of five hundred — best settled

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500

indicators.note: settled suggests the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Arrears of five hundred are best paid off.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrears are sums owed and overdue.

clue.text: A sound measure

parts.note: read sound as noise rather than sensible: a unit for loudness

explanation.surface: A sensible step to take.
explanation.definitionFit: The unit used to measure loudness is a measure of noise.

clue.text: Unfortunately he lacks restraint

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A man unfortunately has no self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: A fetter or manacle restrains a prisoner.

clue.text: The clue here is "a sportsman's dog"

definitions.meaning: a hint or indication of the way
a gun dog that freezes to show where game lies

explanation.surface: Someone declares the hint here is a hunting dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A hint or indicator is one sense; the other is a gundog that indicates game.

clue.text: A woman with articles to put into a case

parts.note: she is a woman
a is the indefinite article
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A woman with goods packs them into a suitcase.
explanation.definitionFit: To place a blade in its scabbard or a knife in its cover is to put it in a case.

clue.text: Requiring a page, ring please

parts.note: a peal is a ring of bells

explanation.surface: Someone needing an attendant asks for a bell to be rung.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Please' looks like a polite request but is a verb: to attract or delight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that attracts or delights you holds charm for you.

clue.text: Duplicated letter from Greece that's precious

indicators.note: duplicated means the Greek letter appears twice in a row

parts.note: chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A doubled Greek letter is said to be precious.
explanation.definitionFit: Chichi means affectedly refined or pretentious, like precious in its showy sense.

clue.text: Nincompoop left in a spot

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for left inside the word for spot

parts.note: a dot is a spot

explanation.surface: A fool is left in a tight corner.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, a fool.

clue.text: List as a matter of course

definitions.meaning: a list of options, as on a computer screen
jokingly, a card that sets out the courses of a meal

explanation.surface: Something that lists things routinely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As a matter of course' sounds like 'routinely' but refers to the courses of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of choices is one sense; the other is the card showing a restaurant's courses.

clue.text: Librarian ensuring all returns are duly dealt with?

definitions.text: Librarian ensuring all returns are duly dealt with?

parts.words: Librarian ensuring all returns are duly dealt with?
parts.note: read returns as financial returns: an accountant who keeps the books, not a library keeper

explanation.surface: A librarian checking that every returned volume is processed.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a library, but returns are tax returns and the books are accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who records a business's financial accounts keeps its books.

clue.text: State a hut should be renovated

indicators.note: renovated suggests rebuilding, so the letters are reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone declares that a hut needs doing up.
explanation.definitionFit: A western US state, home of Salt Lake City.

clue.text: A person dropping everything for youngsters left without shelter

parts.note: a litter is a brood of young animals
out means outdoors, exposed with no shelter

explanation.surface: Someone abandons everything to care for children left out in the cold.
explanation.walkthrough: A LITTER LOUT is British slang for someone who drops rubbish in public.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who drops rubbish anywhere is a careless polluter of public spaces.
